mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (board_title, board_content, board_writer_id, board_like_count, board_view_count, board_write_date) VALUES (#{boardTitle}, #{boardContent}, #{boardWriterId}, #{boardLikeCount}, #{boardViewCount}, #{boardWriteDate})
INSERT INTO board_question (board_id, answer_selected, board_question_category) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{answerSelected}, #{boardQuestionCategory})
INSERT INTO board_adopt (board_id, board_adopt_category, board_adopt_done) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{boardAdoptCategory}, #{boardAdoptDone})
mapper.select: select * from board ORDER BY board_like_count DESC
SELECT b.board_id, b.board_title, b.board_writer_id FROM board b INNER JOIN board_general ga ON b.board_id = ga.board_id WHERE b.board_id=#{boardId}
SELECT b.board_id, b.board_title, b.board_writer_id FROM board b INNER JOIN board_adopt ba ON b.board_id = ba.board_id WHERE b.board_id=#{boardId}
SELECT b.board_id, b.board_title, b.board_writer_id FROM board b INNER JOIN board_question qa ON b.board_id = qa.board_id WHERE b.board_id=#{boardId}
